newsitem.title: USA: Dow extends late tumble, NYSE puts on sidecars.
newsitem.headline: Dow extends late tumble, NYSE puts on sidecars.

text.p: U.S. stocks slumped in late trading with the Dow off more than 120 points in late trading, falling in tandem with bonds. Blue chip, small cap, and tech stocks were all suffering similarly steep losses.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average was off 128 or about 1.4 percent to 7629 with about 50 minutes left in the trading session. The New York Stock Exchange said it put "sidecar" curbs on at 1431 EDT/1831 GMT after the S&P 500 futures index fell over 12 points.
Breadth on the NYSE turned negative, with 1622 decliners compared to 1127 advancers.
